title: India’s External Debt as at the end of March 2026
description: The stock of external debt at end-March 2026 as well as revised data for earlier quarters are set out in Statements I (IMF format1) and II (old format). The major developments relating to India’s external debt as at end-March 2026 are presented below. Highlights At end-March 2026, India’s external debt was placed at US$ 762.8 billion, an increase of US$ 26.3 billion over its level at end-March 2025 (Table 1). The external debt to GDP ratio increased to 20.8 per cent at end-March 2026
